## Vela

**Title:** Shopify Supplement Landing Page: Bundles & Subscriptions

**Role:** Concept build · design, Shopify theme development and integrations

**Description (90 words):**

Goal: a single-product supplement page that sells bundles and subscriptions without leaning on apps. The layout leads with benefits, an evening timeline and an ingredient breakdown, so price arrives after belief. Packs are 1/2/3-jar variants with per-jar savings; subscribe-and-save uses native Shopify selling plans and updates the price live, while a sticky add-to-cart follows the scroll. Testimonials are clearly labelled as samples, not real customers. Built as Online Store 2.0 sections with metaobject ingredients; the public demo runs the theme's own CSS and JavaScript. Lighthouse mobile: 100 performance, 100 accessibility.

**Skills:** Shopify, Shopify Theme Development, Liquid, Conversion Rate Optimization, JavaScript

**Project URL:** https://configuro.studio/shopify-templates/vela

**Images:** `screenshots/vela-desktop-1440.jpg`, `screenshots/vela-mobile-390.jpg`, `lighthouse/vela-lighthouse-mobile.png`

## Shadeline

**Title:** Shopify 3D Pergola Configurator with Live Pricing

**Role:** Concept build · design, Shopify theme development and integrations

**Description (90 words):**

Goal: let buyers size a louvred pergola and see a real price before ever talking to a salesperson. A full-bleed hero leads into a sticky 3D stage beside a three-step configurator: size, finish, add-ons. The 3D view runs a production pergola engine (bays, ZIP screens, LED lighting) that loads only after the buyer scrolls past the hero. Prices come from metafield rules that also generate variant prices, so the live quote matches checkout; exact dimensions travel as line-item properties and add-ons as unit-priced lines. Lighthouse mobile: 100 performance, 100 accessibility.

**Skills:** Shopify, Three.js, 3D Product Configurator, Shopify Theme Development, JavaScript

**Project URL:** https://configuro.studio/shopify-templates/shadeline

**Images:** `screenshots/shadeline-desktop-1440.jpg`, `screenshots/shadeline-mobile-390.jpg`, `lighthouse/shadeline-lighthouse-mobile.png`

## Northgate Supply

**Title:** Shopify B2B Wholesale Portal: Tier Pricing & Quick Order

**Role:** Concept build · design, Shopify theme development and integrations

**Description (89 words):**

Goal: a wholesale storefront where trade buyers apply once, then reorder in under a minute. Guests see list prices and a locked order grid. Approved accounts, identified by a Shopify customer tag, get tiered case pricing and a quick-order grid that can load their last order. Applications use Shopify's native customer form; a webhook service sends them to HubSpot as deals and tags approved buyers back. A Shopify Function enforces tier prices at checkout, and guests never receive tier prices in the HTML. Lighthouse mobile: 100 performance, 100 accessibility.

**Skills:** Shopify, B2B Ecommerce, HubSpot, Shopify Functions, Liquid

**Project URL:** https://configuro.studio/shopify-templates/northgate

**Images:** `screenshots/northgate-desktop-1440.jpg`, `screenshots/northgate-mobile-390.jpg`, `lighthouse/northgate-lighthouse-mobile.png`

## Linkcore

**Title:** Shopify IT Hardware Catalog with Compatibility Checker

**Role:** Concept build · design, Shopify theme development and integrations

**Description (89 words):**

Goal: reduce wrong-dock returns for an IT hardware catalog. A four-product lineup sits beside a “will it work with my setup?” checker that ranks products for the buyer's laptop, monitors and needs, explaining caveats such as one-display MacBooks, MST and 4K at 30 Hz. Specs and compatibility rules live in product metafields, so the comparison table needs no code changes. A tested Python script imports the supplier CSV through the Admin GraphQL API as an idempotent upsert by SKU, so reruns change nothing. Lighthouse mobile: 99 performance, 100 accessibility.

**Skills:** Shopify, Python, GraphQL, Shopify API, JavaScript

**Project URL:** https://configuro.studio/shopify-templates/linkcore

**Images:** `screenshots/linkcore-desktop-1440.jpg`, `screenshots/linkcore-mobile-390.jpg`, `lighthouse/linkcore-lighthouse-mobile.png`

## Aurel

**Title:** Shopify Jewellery Product Drop: Engraving, Countdown & Waitlist

**Role:** Concept build · design, Shopify theme development and integrations

**Description (89 words):**

Goal: an editorial product drop for fine jewellery that builds anticipation without losing the sale. A large serif hero carries a countdown read from a drop-date metafield. Before launch the buy box collects waitlist emails, then switches to add-to-bag on time without a reload. Buyers choose metal and size, open a ring-size drawer and type an engraving that previews live inside the band, limited by a metafield and saved as a line-item property. Built entirely as Online Store 2.0 sections, with no apps. Lighthouse mobile: 100 performance, 100 accessibility.

**Skills:** Shopify, Shopify Theme Development, Web Design, Liquid, UX Design

**Project URL:** https://configuro.studio/shopify-templates/aurel
